description: Ilyushin Il-28 standing in a landscaped plot with curving paths on the western edge of Aleppo International Airport at Nayrab, next to the southern ring road. Recorded by spottingmode in December 2017 with no airframe linked, so no serial is available. Confirmed present and apparently structurally complete on Esri imagery of 23 April 2024, meaning it survived the entire war on the Aleppo front line. This is the single most significant survivor found in Syria outside Damascus.
